description: Automatically detect and trim leading/trailing silence from audio, then export WAV.

faqs.a: It scans from each end for the first sample louder than your threshold (in dB), ignoring silences shorter than your minimum.
Set the threshold in dB and the minimum silence length in seconds, then press Detect.
faqs.q: How do I tune the detection?

faqs.a: A 16-bit PCM WAV of the trimmed audio; the result shows exactly how much was removed from each end.

howto: Drop an audio file into the tool.
Set the silence threshold and minimum silence length.
Detect silence, then click Download WAV.
title: Audio Trim Silence
